role_boundary: This agent authored the original 4 MiB regression fixture. This record is a scoped read-only CI diagnosis, not an independent technical acceptance of its own authored fixture.
follow_up_commit_verification_scope: Commit identity and final fixed-clock adoption were supplied by parent; this archive-only step did not inspect or execute the final commit.

actions_completed: Read exact published tests/sessions.cpp and CMakeLists.txt using git show b88b76302e850499275b0a8ec2db366f282481f1.
Read relevant source paths in src/sessions.cpp, src/store.cpp, and src/web.cpp; git diff against the published baseline for these production paths was empty at inspection time.
Inspect bounded fixture loops, source processing, transaction rollback, clock deadlines, SQLite busy timeout, and stdout flushing.
Inspect the parent concurrent Windows timeout and flushed per-case timing edits without modifying them.
scope.ci_timing_provenance: Timings and suite outcomes below were reported by parent from the exact published commit CI.

bounded_workload_findings.worker_type: In-process synthetic WorkerPort; no worker subprocess or HTTP call in this fixture.
bounded_workload_findings.bound_qualification: These are upper bounds, not measured counts. Rejected source transactions are rolled back, so actual cumulative work may be lower.
bounded_workload_findings.processing: Each completion re-reads retained completed source payloads, reconstructs provenance, fuses results, checks publication/site bindings, inserts a version, and sums session storage. The 4 MiB check occurs after candidate result insertion, so rejected versions also incur processing and rollback work.
bounded_workload_findings.bounded_control_flow: One initial execute_one plus a fixed loop of 19 execute_one calls. Missing lease fails a CHECK immediately; there is no retry-until-success loop.
bounded_workload_findings.locking_observation: On freeze rejection, stack unwinding releases the completion transaction and Store lock before execute_search invokes fail_search. No concrete same-lock recursive acquisition was found on this path.
bounded_workload_findings.source_throttle_observation: The fixture min_interval_ms is zero, so the bounded source politeness sleep is not entered.
bounded_workload_findings.finding_limit: Static inspection found no explicit Windows-specific unbounded loop or deadlock in the inspected path; it does not prove absence of all runtime or platform faults.

stdout_observability.finding: The published harness prints PASS only after a case completes, using newline without an explicit flush. There is no pre-case RUN line. Missing captured stdout therefore cannot locate the timeout to the first case or prove where progress stopped.
stdout_observability.recommended_change: Print and flush RUN before each case and PASS after it, with steady_clock elapsed time.

timeout_budget_estimate.method: Apply parent-reported same-job Windows/Linux slowdown ratios of core and capacity_cycles to Linux sessions elapsed time.
timeout_budget_estimate.inference: The estimate exceeds the published whole-suite 60-second budget and supports a bounded Windows-only budget increase. It cannot establish the actual duration or isolate the failing subcase.
timeout_budget_estimate.existing_comparator_reference: Published CMakeLists.txt:135 already gives capacity_cycles TIMEOUT 180.

real_clock_coupling.risk: A sufficiently slow runner can hit product deadlines even after the external CTest budget is raised. This would produce deadline/unknown-source behavior or assertion failures rather than an infinite wait.
real_clock_coupling.recommendation: Use a fixed controllable Store clock in this storage-only fixture, sharing the same clock for initial open and reopen.
real_clock_coupling.why_scope_is_preserved: The fixture asserts storage backpressure, transaction rollback, retained counters, and immutable result pages; it does not assert elapsed-time semantics. A fixed Store clock isolates these properties while preserving all 20 sources, 30 hits per source, the actual 4 MiB threshold, and all existing assertions. CTest and per-case steady_clock timing remain real wall-time bounds/measurements.
real_clock_coupling.must_remain_unchanged: Dedicated real deadline and fault/recovery end-to-end tests; production deadline and lease behavior.
real_clock_coupling.adoption_status: Parent reports both Store instances now share the fixed clock in ffbe9515c9c0349e0eee7a484da85dacced7ad9c, with complete fixture/assertions preserved and real deadline E2E unchanged.

conclusion.text: Existing evidence better supports a Windows Debug workload exceeding the old 60-second suite budget than a demonstrated logic hang. A Windows-only 180-second timeout, flushed case progress/timing, and a shared fixed Store clock in the storage-only fixture are justified narrowly scoped changes. The original timeout remains a failure.
conclusion.required_confirmation: Run the corrected exact commit on Windows and inspect complete per-case output and whole-suite results. No future CI result, final Windows pass, or full product acceptance is claimed.
